selection.source: all frozen coverage-gap candidates from gap-audit.json

method.subject: exact repository head_sha from the frozen source audit
method.observation: supported root or bounded nested test command declared in reconstructed metadata
method.execution: metadata-only; no repository command, dependency or code is executed

claim_boundary: This remeasurement can show that bounded nested metadata discovery removes some root-only missing-test warnings. It cannot establish that tests pass, cover business behavior, are accepted by maintainers, change merge decisions, create retention, justify payment or outperform another product.
stopping_rule: Process all 60 frozen observations; do not stop on a favorable result.
mutation_rule: Do not change the source corpus, exact SHAs, selection or interpretation after collection starts.
